ValidationRule.description: An opportunity with open Complete Success Plan tasks can't be submitted for approval
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(ISPICKVAL(StageName,"Closed Won – Pending Approval"), Has_Open_Complete_Success_Plan_Task__c = TRUE,
$Profile.Name <> 'Custom: Fin/Ops/HR', $Profile.Name <> 'ALM - Custom: Fin/Ops/HR', $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator',NOT($Setup.Application_Settings__c.Disable_Validation_Rules__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You have open Complete Success Plan tasks on this opportunity. Please complete them before closing the opportunity.
